page.overview:
Who is Carl Forberg?

Carl Forberg (born 4 March 1911 and died 17 January 2000) was an American racing driver who participated in three Indianapolis 500 races between and . At this time, results from the race were included in the Formula One championship, although Forberg scored no championship points. He qualified for a single event, finishing in 7th position at the 1951 Indianapolis 500.
